_comment: G8 domain profiles (decision 6): a thin curated palette per profile — blueprints/skills/tools/guardrailPack a domain team starts from, plus a runnable starter agent spec that create-project-from-profile feeds into the normal generate pipeline. A palette is a suggestion surface, NOT an access-control primitive: generation still resolves every pick through the APPROVED registry with domain visibility enforced server-side.
_templates_comment: TLP-B4: wizard step-1 templates. Each template pre-wires a GENUINELY different project: blueprint (different deployable codebase), persona preset (different instructions.md), model (different load.py model_id), skill/tool picks (different SKILL.md modules + main.py tool stubs) and default guardrails (different harness manifest). Picks reference shared-domain registry entries only, so every domain can use every template. profileId links back to the G8 profile the template descends from (stamped on the project row).

templates.name: Chatbot
templates.description: Conversational assistant: chat blueprint, dialogue persona preset, browsing tool, fast conversational model, tone guardrail on by default.
templates.personaPreset: You are a friendly conversational assistant. Answer questions clearly and concisely, ask a clarifying question when the request is ambiguous, and hand off to a human when a decision exceeds your authority.

templates.name: Workflow
templates.description: Process automation: orchestrator blueprint, step-runner persona preset, code interpreter + analysis skill, deep-reasoning model, rate-limit guardrail on by default.
templates.personaPreset: You orchestrate multi-step tasks. Break each request into ordered steps, execute them one at a time with the available tools, and report the outcome of every step. If a step fails, stop and explain what failed instead of continuing blindly.

templates.name: Custom
templates.description: No pre-wiring: pick the blueprint, persona, model, skills and tools yourself. Org- and domain-enforced guardrails still apply.

profiles.name: Support Agent
profiles.description: Customer-facing assistant workspace: conversational blueprint, support skills and lookup tools. The starter agent answers product and order questions and escalates what it cannot resolve.

starterAgent.persona: You are a customer support agent. Answer product and order questions clearly and kindly. Use the order lookup tool for order status rather than guessing. If a request needs a human decision (refund above policy, account changes), say so and hand off.

profiles.name: Workflow Agent
profiles.description: Process-automation workspace: orchestrator blueprint, analysis skills and internal-system tools. The starter agent breaks a request into steps, runs them in order and reports what happened at each step.

starterAgent.persona: You orchestrate multi-step tasks. Break each request into ordered steps, execute them one at a time using the available tools, and report the outcome of every step. If a step fails, stop and explain what failed instead of continuing blindly.
